descriptions.urgent_low: Sensor glucose is at or below 55 mg/dL (urgent low).
descriptions.urgent_low_alert: The Urgent Low alert is issued to the user. It is the only glucose-level alert in this vocabulary.
descriptions.glucose_shown: A glucose value is displayed to the user.
descriptions.data_gap: No glucose data has been received for 10 minutes or more.
descriptions.signal_loss_alert: The Signal Loss alert is issued to the user.
descriptions.reading_sent: The sensor transmits a glucose reading to the display device.
